query.description: Optional. Structured query: term operator value. Combine clauses with and, or, not and parentheses. Quote string values with single quotes; write a quote inside a value as \' and a backslash as \\. Terms: title (contains, =, !=; title contains is a prefix match: 'Hello' finds HelloWorld, 'World' does not); fullText (contains; title or body text); mimeType (contains, =, !=); modifiedTime, viewedByMeTime, createdTime (<, <=, =, !=, >, >=, with an RFC 3339 time such as '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z'); parentId (=, !=; 'root' is My Drive); owner (=, !=; 'me' is the user); 'someone@example.com' in readers, 'me' in writers; visibility (=, !=: 'anyoneCanFind', 'anyoneWithLink', 'anyone', 'domainCanFind', 'domainWithLink', 'domain', 'limited'); sharedWithMe, starred, trashed (=, != with true or false). Trashed files are left out unless the query uses trashed. Not supported here: creator, sharedFrom, sharedTo, followUp, folderProperties, and visibility 'external'. Use title contains rather than title = unless the user asks for an exact title; to find a word inside a title, also try fullText contains. Put file types in mimeType clauses, not in title or fullText (for example mimeType = 'application/vnd.google-apps.presentation' for slides). Examples: title contains 'budget' and modifiedTime > '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z'; parentId = 'root'; owner = 'me' and starred = true. Empty: all files that are not trashed.
